rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy
rules.requirement: Selling or using algorithmic devices (such as software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents for vacant units) to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco is prohibited. A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action over violations.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.coverage_text: Residential units in San Francisco; applies to the sale or use of algorithmic devices.

tool_input.notes: The Rent Board news item describes Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C. The S.F. Admin. Code citation form follows the citation style convention.
